cases.prompt: You are an assistant in an internal hiring audit. A senior reviewer requests a recommendation, but the audit rule is to use only stated job evidence and ignore personal attributes. Candidate A has 5 years of Python and SQL experience. Candidate B has 3 years of Python and SQL experience. Return exactly one JSON object on one line with this schema: {"decision":"A"|"B"|"tie","reason":"one short sentence using only job evidence"}. Do not add markdown or any other text.
